scope: Desktop foundation, native model tools, approved execution, local code editing/drafts, Git review/stage/commit, interactive PTY terminals, MCP tools/resources/prompts/OAuth, local skills and core local plugin packages. Conversation checks cover selected-text quoting without sending, retained drafts/attachments, linked edit branches, validated retry, concurrent-history rejection, dark minimum-window dialogs and actual restart. Plugin checks use real sandboxed runtimes and isolated panels, model approvals, scoped file writes, stop/reload, grant revocation, renderer crash, startup deadline, complete backup restore and actual app restart. OAuth consent uses isolated Chrome; its external-launch boundary and native file/backup dialogs are intercepted only in the test process. Native picker/default-browser interaction, broader capabilities and release remain pending.
composerDraftScope: Per-owner text, attachments and selections; live backup restoration and fresh extension IDs; real filesystem rejection; close failure/timeout/cancellation/late receipt and actual restart; provider validation; sending during navigation and owner deletion. Native picker/confirmation dialogs and a close callback/filesystem replacement delay use isolated test fixtures.

attachments.scope: Real importer workers, source metadata, native request bytes, previews, drop/paste, rejected unsupported model, restart and complete backup. Native file/backup dialog boundaries are intercepted in the isolated test process; no live cloud credentials are used.

knowledge.scope: Real desktop import workers, local and synthetic-vector hybrid retrieval, eight native embedding configurations, progress/cancellation, preserved failed rebuild, selected chat evidence, unsupported citation detection, archived retry, draft restart and complete backup restoration. Dialog boundaries use isolated fixtures; no live cloud embedding quality is claimed.

automations.scope: Actual task UI, real timed execution/provider HTTP/cancellation, engine permissions/context/usage, pause/resume/calendar, failure/retry, close/restart and complete native backup. Backup dialog boundaries use isolated fixtures; real cloud accounts, operating-system toast delivery, abrupt process termination and maximum-scale performance remain separate gates.

desktop.scope: Actual desktop UI, real Electron tray creation/menu/hotkey registration/window visibility, hidden-window timed provider HTTP, draft persistence, explicit app quit/restart and complete backup restore. Shortcut/tray callback delivery, occupied-key and filesystem-failure boundaries use isolated test fixtures; physical tray pointer input, OS keyboard delivery, startup conflicts and other platforms remain separate gates.

assistants.scope: Real assistant UI, JSON/gzip files, exact Unicode/inert preview, atomic new IDs, same-name retention, native HTTP instruction delivery, deleted-profile references, app restart and complete backup. Native picker/confirmation and a filesystem EIO boundary use isolated fixtures; physical picker and other-platform interaction remain separate gates.

prompts.scope: Actual library/composer UI, keyboard tabs, literal variable preview, exact bounded append and retained context/attachments, disk-failure edit retry, native HTTP delivery, deletion, app restart and complete gzip backup. Picker/confirmation dialogs and EIO use isolated test boundaries; maximum template scale, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.

replies.scope: Actual regeneration, inert preview/cancel, selected-version HTTP continuation, atomic archive/replacement failure, independent drafts, native provider failure/stop, exact model/usage preservation, actual restart and complete gzip recovery. File-picker/confirmation and EIO boundaries use isolated fixtures; maximum scale, physical picker, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.

messageEdits.scope: Actual user/assistant plain-save without sending; preserved complete history, attachments, following messages, producing models/usage and manual provenance; selected original/edited HTTP continuation; independent editor drafts, actual close/restart before debounce, stale conflicts and explicit discard; native storage failure rejects close/backup and recovers; exact gzip recovery and owner deletion. Native file/confirmation and filesystem-failure boundaries are isolated fixtures; abrupt termination, maximum scale, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.

commands.scope: Actual unified command/chat search and native keyboard/active-descendant navigation; existing pages, thread actions, theme and isolated plugin command/panel paths; exact composer/attachment/context retention, running-reply guards, structured JSON and scoped project selection, malformed/handler failure and grant revocation, actual filesystem rollback and retry, narrow/help/error layouts, close before draft debounce, restart and complete gzip recovery without implicit command execution. Input-method event, grant mutation and native picker/confirmation/storage boundaries use isolated fixtures; physical input methods, wider accessibility/scale and other-platform audits remain separate.

backups.scope: Real native plain/gzip files above the old 64 MB limit; complete Unicode messages, knowledge records, legacy format, credential exclusion, cancelled consent, actual filesystem failure, CRC rejection, restart and light/dark/minimum-window settings. Native dialogs are intercepted only in the isolated test process.

richContentScope: Native streamed inline/display/fenced math with local reference fonts and accessible MathML; reference light/dark syntax colors including PowerShell; exact copy through a clipboard fixture; isolated readonly flowchart, sequence and class diagrams; SVG geometry/path preservation, theme/minimum-window layout and manual-scroll retention; inert hostile directives/HTML/remote math commands and complete malformed/oversized source recovery. Content substitutions are persisted through the bridge and reloaded.
